title: CORE DataSource
description: Configuration for a data source that feeds data into a CORE pipeline. The connector-specific fields are chosen by 'connectionType' (mqtt | sql | http); each variant declares exactly the fields the host persists (the connector configuration POJO). Only the fields whose description says 'Stored ENCRYPTED' are stored ENCRYPTED by the host — every other field is stored as-is. 'element' references the DataStructure describing the payload format by versioned CORE URN.

MqttDataSource.title: MQTT DataSource
MqttDataSource.description: Subscribes to one or more MQTT brokers and topics.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSource.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the DataStructure that describes the payload format.

topics.description: MQTT topic filter(s) to subscribe to. Wildcards (+, #) are supported.

qos.description: MQTT Quality of Service level: 0, 1 or 2.

tls.description: TLS settings for the broker connection.

password.description: MQTT password. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

SqlDataSource.title: SQL DataSource
SqlDataSource.description: Polls a relational database via a JDBC/SQL query.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSource.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the DataStructure that describes the row format.

driver.description: Database driver, e.g. 'postgres'. Only 'postgres' is wired in the NiFi engine.

dsn.description: Connection URL / data-source name (embedded credentials are stripped).

password.description: Database login password. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

HttpDataSource.title: HTTP/REST DataSource
HttpDataSource.description: Reads from an HTTP/REST API with one or more named GET API calls.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSource.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the DataStructure that describes the payload format.

baseUrl.description: API host: an http or https URL without user info, query, fragment or trailing '/'.

authentication.description: Authentication of every API call, chosen by 'type'.

apiCalls.description: The GET API calls. A source node names the one it reads by 'apiCallName'.

password.description: Basic auth password. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

token.description: Bearer token, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

name.description: Name of the header or query parameter that carries the token.

value.description: API token. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

in.description: Where each request sends the token.

tokenUrl.description: Token endpoint of the client credentials grant: an https URL without user info, query or fragment.

clientSecret.description: Client secret. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

scope.description: Scope of the access token, space-separated; null for none.

certificate.description: Client certificate in PEM, optionally followed by its chain. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

privateKey.description: Private key of the certificate in PEM, without a passphrase. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

name.description: Name of the API call, unique within the DataSource.

method.description: HTTP method. Only GET is supported.

pagination.description: Pagination of the API call, chosen by 'type'; null for none.

pageParameter.description: Query parameter that carries the page number.

pageSizeParameter.description: Query parameter that carries the page size.

endPage.description: Last page number; null for no end page.

limitParameter.description: Query parameter that carries the limit; set together with 'limit'. Null sends no limit, so the offset grows by the number of records of each response.

offsetParameter.description: Query parameter that carries the offset.

limit.description: Number of records per request; set together with 'limitParameter'.

offset.description: Offset of the first request; null is 0.

countPath.description: JSON path in the response to the number of records, or to an array whose length is that number; null counts the elements of the response, which is then an array.

nextLinkPath.description: Restricted JSON path in the response to the next link, a string or an object with a string href.

maxLinks.description: Maximum number of links to follow; null follows all links. A run sends at most 1000 requests and stops with an error when the last one still holds a link, so a value above 999 has no effect.

cursorPath.description: JSON path in the response to the cursor of the next request.

cursorParameter.description: Name of the query parameter or header that carries the cursor.

cursorIn.description: Where each request sends the cursor.

limitParameter.description: Query parameter that carries the limit; set together with 'limit'. Null sends no limit.

limit.description: Number of records per request; set together with 'limitParameter'.
